mutations.name: H-DOCDATA
mutations._mechanism: Remove the doc/data exemption so a listed document reaches the judge.

mutations.name: H-DOCDATA-LINE
mutations._mechanism: Accept malformed doc/data output instead of refusing its protocol error.

mutations.name: H-LIST-LINES
mutations._mechanism: Remove the listing line-count guard; the test must retain its specific refusal reason.
mutations.find: case "$LOUT" in *$'\n'*|"") _refuse judge-error "listing verb printed zero or several lines" ;; esac  # M:H-LIST-LINES

mutations.name: H-LIST-RC
mutations._mechanism: Trust not-listed output despite a nonzero listing exit status.

mutations.name: H-LIST-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Drop the listing-specific unreadable refusal; the test distinguishes the fallback reason.

mutations.name: H-LIST-DECODE
mutations._mechanism: Decode through bare command substitution, stripping a listed name's trailing newline.

mutations.name: H-LIST-NAME
mutations._mechanism: Accept a listed target that was never supplied among canonical names.
mutations.find: _refuse judge-error "listing verb named a target it was not given"  # M:H-LIST-NAME

mutations.name: H-LIST-INROOT
mutations._mechanism: Read the governing root's unreadable state for an outside-root code-like target.

mutations.name: H-NO-DIR-ALLOW
mutations._mechanism: Prematurely exempt directories through doc/data before the existing Bash 3.2 name loop.

mutations.name: H-NOT-LISTED
mutations._mechanism: Drop the unlisted allow branch while keeping the listing call intact.

mutations.name: H-LIST-UNRECOGNISED
mutations._mechanism: Return without a verdict on unrecognised listing output; the test checks the protocol refusal reason.
mutations.find: _refuse judge-error "listing verb printed no well-formed listing line"  # M:H-LIST-UNRECOGNISED

mutations.name: H-CODE-LIKE
mutations._mechanism: Skip the code-like listing branch; the pin must distinguish no-test-resolved from test-missing.

mutations.name: H-LIST-CONTEXT
mutations._mechanism: Remove selected-target context from code-like denial diagnostics; S2 must expose the selected production name as well as its resolved test.

mutations.name: W7R
mutations._mechanism: Replace the judge listing launch with a constant not-listed answer; a listed absent-test write must still be judged and denied, so the listed-DENY test must fail.

mutations.name: W7F
mutations._mechanism: Replace the judge listing launch with a constant listed answer naming the given target; the unlisted code-like control must stay ALLOW, so it must fail.

mutations.name: H-LIST-NAMES
mutations._mechanism: Claude must hand the verb every canonical name; only the canonical target misses a listed hard link and wrongly admits the write.
mutations.find: for name in "${CANON_NAMES[@]}"; do LARGS[${#LARGS[@]}]=--name; LARGS[${#LARGS[@]}]=${CANON_TARGET%/*}/$name; done

mutations.name: H-LIST-TARGET
mutations._mechanism: Claude must judge the target the listing selected; the last canonical name flips selection scenarios S1 and S2 and wrongly admits S2.

mutations.name: H-DOCDATA-NO-ARM
mutations._mechanism: A code-like target must read docdata no and stay on the listing path; the yes arm exempts every code-like write.
